% Pattern: proof/extent. A \proof without an end mark ends at two empty lines
% in a row, and the remark after them is not part of the proof. A comment line
% is not empty. Seen in the gold pilot (set E).
% want theorem-1 statement/theorem 1 status=here
% want head-1 proof - proves=theorem-1 lines=12-15
% want lemma-1 statement/lemma 2 status=none
\documentclass{amsart}
\newtheorem{theorem}{Theorem}
\newtheorem{lemma}[theorem]{Lemma}
\begin{document}
\begin{theorem} Every compact space is bounded. \end{theorem}
\proof Cover the space by balls and take a finite subcover.
%
%
The union of finitely many balls is bounded.


The theorem can also be proved with nets.
\begin{lemma} Every closed subset of a compact space is compact. \end{lemma}
\end{document}
